text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Aw man, they're all here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The guys from back home. Even though it's
only a school event, it
looks like they've
come all the way here to cheer me on...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's more, they're all buddy-buddy now
with the folks from the
local shopping
district sitting next to them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And their current topic of choice? Me.
They're getting on like a house
on fire.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wha—et tu, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh maaan, you better not have any expectations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In spite of what Nature said,
I see a flash
of determination cross her
face as she
enters the gate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally, the Tracen Meet kicks off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Nature and Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners have rounded the first
turn! In fourth—Nice Nature!
Trailing behind in
fifth by one and a half lengths is the fan
 favorite—Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I'm already feeling the pressure!
...Even though I bet Teio isn't
even trying
to do so!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(But... I've got her exactly where I want
her!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Time for me to go all-out!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Tokai Teio is making her
move! She's blazing past the
competition
in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Not good—Teio's in the zone! If I don't
act now, she'll leave me in
the dust!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature rejoins the pack,
and she's got
her sights locked on Tokai
Teio! Now for
the final turn...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio leads the pack!
Nice Nature in third! She's
speeding up
and giving fierce chase!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio, leading by two lengths! Wait,
make that two and half—now three!
There's no stopping her now... and she's
past the
winning post!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio claims first place with a
flashy
finish!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw, I got real close today!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, third place isn't bad,
right? Nothing
to get down in the dumps
about.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If anything,
I'd say this is perfect for me.
Yup, yup, this is just right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Really... this is my limit, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt. Is Nature here by any
chance?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-yeah, why? You need something
from me?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
There was a delivery for you. Mind if I
drop it off here?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The teacher brings in a large box. Opening
it, we find the box filled
to the brim with
letters addressed to Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Dear Natie..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You were great in today's race, as usual.
It's a shame how it ended,
but to us,
seeing you run is already more than we
could ever ask for."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even when you're not here with us,
talking
about you always puts big
ol' smiles on our
faces."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting you and watching you grow into
such a fine Umamusume has
been the
pleasure of our lives."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"We'll always be cheering you on, so don't
forget to cheer yourself on
too."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What's... up with that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What... What are they talking about?
Smiles? Me? I'm not—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aaaaargh! Augh! Ah, ngh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: D... dammit! Dammit, dammit, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's up with me and third?! Every!
Single! Time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best? It was close?
It wasn't that
bad? There's no way that
third's all I'm
good for!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I kept taking the easy way out, telling
myself that I wasn't built for it,
that I was an extra!
Wallowing in self pity to protect
my petty pride!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be disappointed—I didn't
want to disappoint... I was
afraid of getting
hurt again, so I tried to make everyone
give up on me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... but still!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I don't want things to end like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Everyone's cheering me on. Everyone's telling me that even I deserve to dream. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I... want to make them proud. I want them
to see me shine!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ah, wait, um...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Agh... Gotta stop giving myself a way out.
Once I start going down
that slippery
slope...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being all wishy-washy.
It'll take
some time before I can
muster up the
courage to be more confident.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But... well,
you know. If you're still fine
with training me, then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You got it, Trainer!
